## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c9ef2ce5d717b0f0fdce194aece031e5c2837592`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Measured on a scratch-worktree build of the head** (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline` exit 0, `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/cli..." build` exit 0, worktree removed afterwards; main checkout untouched, `git status` clean). Each probe alone in its own directory, `check` run with that directory as cwd:
  - `{ "type": "line-chart" }`, `{ "type": "view:dashboard" }`, `{ "type": "map" }`: each prints `Skipped 1 file with a root "type" that no ObjectUI recogniser admitted.` then `✓ All checks passed`, exit 0, no unknown-type line.
  - Controls with `"className": "h-64"`: `⚠️ Unknown schema type "line-chart" in line-chart-structural.json` (likewise `view:dashboard`, `map`), exit 0.
  - `objectui validate` on all six: exit 1, `Path: type`, `Code: invalid_union`, `No arm accepts type "X".` — so "refuses the document at `type` (`invalid_union`) and exits non-zero" is correct in every corrected sentence and note.
  - Dev's extra reading confirmed: bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` prints `⚠️ 1 file carries a registered ObjectUI component type but did not validate as an ObjectUI schema: view-map.json (type "view:map")`, exit 0 — advisory list, not skipped; `{ "type": "view:map", "className": "h-64" }` prints nothing; `validate` on bare view:map exits 1 at `type`, `invalid_union`. Control bare `{ "type": "dashboard" }` also lands in the advisory list.
  - Known-type list at head (`packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`): 0 literals for `line-chart`, `view:dashboard`, `map`; 1 for `view:map` (line 657). So every note's "counted as skipped" is true for the three documents; no note says "skips" where the truth is "lists", nor the reverse. The notes' recogniser description matches `check.ts` lines 143-148, 287-311, 351-356 exactly, and reuses PR #10523's wording (`content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` lines 448-454, `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx` lines 197-213) faithfully.
- **One untouched sentence in an edited bullet is false for the bare document and is now contradicted by the PR's own note.** `.changeset/10393-retire-bare-map-key.md` line 48-49 (head) still says of `view:map`: "and `objectui check` does not flag it". Measured above: a bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` IS flagged, by name, with a ⚠️ line. The new dated note four lines below says a non-validating file "is listed by name when its root `type` is on that known-type list", and the same bullet says `view:map` "stays on that list", so the entry now states the contradiction itself. The PR reworded the first sentence of this very bullet to "in a file it recognises" and left the second unscoped; the dev measured it (Acceptance notes) and left it. Changesets publish verbatim: this must be fixed. Exact replacement for the clause "and `objectui check` does not flag it. Search documents for `view:map` directly.":
  "and `objectui check` does not report it as an unknown schema type in a file it recognises. A bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` with no structural key is listed in `check`'s advisory did-not-validate list instead, because `view:map` is on that list and `AnyComponentSchema` has no arm for it; that line does not say the node renders a placeholder. Search documents for `view:map` directly."
- **"Corrected, not scoped" is right.** `7dc08a3e7` = 2026-08-25 "feat(cli): recognise ObjectUI schemas by validity, and report the broken ones (#6322)". `git merge-base --is-ancestor 7dc08a3e7 X` exit 0 for X = `6a4680b57` (2026-09-12, #9225, first add of 8760), `e356c39ee` (2026-09-18, #9803, first add of 9533), `64563a915` (2026-09-25, #10540, first add of 10393); control `is-ancestor 7dc08a3e7 7dc08a3e7^` exit 1; repo not shallow. `check.ts` at all three commits has the structural-key recogniser, the `skipped++` branch and the `isUnvalidatedCandidate` bucket; `check.ts` and `validate.ts` are byte-identical from `64563a915` to the head. PR #10595's body took the same route: "for the other ten I did not use 'at this change' scoping. Those sentences were never true of `check`, so scoping them would assert a false history."
- **Frontmatter byte-identical** (md5 of the `---` block at base `5add18a67` and at head): 8760 `24d9e155a9fe760e502862226ced2ba3`, 9533 `04b5781f09530b1c4efda2273bc5a87a`, 10393 `02a248bf14464234d9665bad2c91931b`.
- **Sweep** at main `4a3d500fd` (`git grep` over `.changeset` for `objectui check` and `check` near reports/flags/refuses/Unknown schema type, plus unknown-type phrasings): no other pending changeset promises a `check` diagnostic on a bare-root document. Read and standing: `unknown-component-type-case-suggestion-5247` (quotes the warning text, no document quoted), `9641` (removes a false positive, promises no diagnostic), `8499:97`, `6939:38`, `7113:79` (advisory-list census claims), the eleven `objectui#10524` dated notes, `8802:132-139` ("will NOT flag either namespaced spelling … still validate green" — an absence claim of the same shape as 10393's view:map sentence; a bare `{ "type": "view:kanban" }` would most likely land in the advisory list too; not measured, outside this card's class, noted for the seat).
- **No stacked contradictions**: at base none of the three files carried a dated note (0 "Dated note", 0 "10524" hits each); PR #10595 touched none of them; each file gains exactly one note.

### ② Semver level

No released source changed; `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report` and `Changeset Claim Re-read` all green on the head. `Clause-②: no` is correct. Package levels in the three frontmatters unchanged (md5 above).

**Title misdescribes the change.** It says "scope three `objectui check` sentences to files it recognises". The diff changes four sentences in three files; only two are scoped by adding "in a file it recognises" (9533 What changed, 10393 cli bullet); the other two (8760 Breaking, 9533 Breaking) have the `check` claim deleted and a `validate` sentence put in its place, which the body itself calls "corrected, not scoped". A squash merge publishes this title. Exact replacement:
`docs(changesets): correct four `objectui check` sentences in three pending changesets; `check` skips the bare document, `objectui validate` gives the verdict (objectui#10606)`

### ③ Boundary flags

- **CI on the head**: 41 check runs, all completed — 37 success, 4 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, coverage shard, `dependabot`, not applicable); commit status `Vercel` success. No red check.
- **merge-tree** `refs/review/pr-10642` against main `4a3d500fd`: clean, tree `7f6ab865b`, exit 0. Main has 12 commits since base `5add18a67`, none touching the three files.
- **Release PR #5400** (`changeset-release/main` at `bc117427f`, generated 2026-09-18 from main `06611e448` of 2026-09-17): its snapshot predates 9533 and 10393 but has already CONSUMED 8760 — it deletes `.changeset/8760-unfulfilled-chart-stubs.md` (62 lines) and `apps/console/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md` on that branch each carry the false sentence "`objectui check` reports `Unknown schema type "line-chart"`". Merging #5400 as it stands ships the defect and conflicts with this PR's 8760 edit (modify vs delete). This PR must land before #5400 is regenerated and merged; the seat should hold #5400 until then.
- **PR state**: draft, assignee unset (the dev's `label-write --assign` was refused by the classifier). Needs assignment to `os-elon-musk` and un-drafting before it can land.
- No source, no test, no new changeset; the overwrite gate is report-only and green.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-10606-check-bare-doc-changesets`
Reviewed-by: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Two wording items stop landing, both with exact replacement text above: (1) `.changeset/10393-retire-bare-map-key.md` line 48-49, "`objectui check` does not flag it" — measured false for a bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` (advisory list, by name) and contradicted by the PR's own dated note in the same file; (2) the PR title, which a squash merge publishes, says "scope three" sentences where four were changed and two were corrected outright. Everything else in ①–③ holds; the release-PR ordering in ③ is a seat action, not a defect in this PR.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3f0f8eca3e1caab5ef2a650c6250bf628afbd4af`

### ① Derived judgments

Diff `c9ef2ce5d..3f0f8eca3`: one file, `.changeset/10393-retire-bare-map-key.md`, the one `@object-ui/cli` bullet (+6/−2). `7467d4e39..3f0f8eca3` is one word swap on one line, "that" to "the known-type", nothing else. Front-matter block md5 `02a248bf14464234d9665bad2c91931b` at `5add18a67`, `c9ef2ce5d`, `7467d4e39` and `3f0f8eca3`.

Rewritten bullet, sentence by sentence, checked at source and measured with the CLI built from the head in a scratch worktree (removed afterwards):
- "no longer contains bare `map`": `known-schema-types.ts` has no `map` entry (list runs `main`, `mark`). True.
- "reports `map` as an unknown schema type in a file it recognises": `check.ts` 287–311, structural arm admits, `isKnownSchemaType('map')` false, warning printed. True.
- "`view:map` stays on that list, because … `registerPlaceholders()` … registers it": `known-schema-types.ts` 657 `'view:map'` (and 411 `'protocol-placeholder:view:map'`); `placeholders.tsx` 48 lists `'view:map'`, 139 registers under namespace `protocol-placeholder` without `skipFallback`, so the bare spelling is a real key. True.
- "does not report it as an unknown schema type in a file it recognises": measured `{ "type": "view:map", "className": "h-64" }` alone in a directory: `Analyzing 1 files...` then `All checks passed`, exit 0, no line about the file. True.
- "A bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` with no structural key is listed in `check`'s advisory did-not-validate list instead": measured: `1 file carries a registered ObjectUI component type but did not validate as an ObjectUI schema:` then `   view-map.json (type "view:map")`, exit 0. True.
- "because `view:map` is on the known-type list and `AnyComponentSchema` has no arm for it": `check.ts` lists iff `!isObjectUiSchemaFile` (143–148: no `OBJECTUI_STRUCTURAL_KEYS` member, and `safeValidateSchema(content).success` false) and `isUnvalidatedCandidate` (186–188, = `isKnownSchemaType`). `safeValidateSchema` is `AnyComponentSchema.safeParse` (`index.zod.ts` 541–543); `AnyComponentSchema` is `defineNodeComponentUnion(z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...13 sub-unions]))` (465–479) and the wrapper returns the union unchanged (`base.zod.ts` 140, `return union`). `packages/types/src` has zero `view:map` literals and no computed `view:` literal; `validate` on the bare file says `No arm accepts type "view:map"`. With the sentence's own premise "with no structural key", the two stated reasons are exactly the listing condition. True.
- "that line does not say the node renders a placeholder": the two printed lines (`check.ts` 330, 334) name only the file and its type. True.
- Coherence with the dated note: the note says a non-validating keyless file "is listed by name when its root `type` is on that known-type list, and is otherwise counted as skipped"; `{ "type": "map" }` measured as `Skipped 1 file …`, exit 0. The bullet is the listed case, the note the skipped case; they agree, and the note is unchanged since `c9ef2ce5d`.

Landing title (`title-10642.txt`, 161 chars): three pending changesets (8760, 9533, 10393) each now say what `check` does with the bare document (skipped, skipped, and for 10393 both skipped `map` and listed `view:map`), and each names `objectui validate` for the verdict. True for every edited sentence including the `view:map` one.

Landing body (`pr-body-10642-r3.md`): "What changed" row for 10393, the H4 row, the round-2 paragraph and the round-3 paragraph are true. Verified: the clause text quoted equals the head text; `'object-map'` quoted literal has 3 hits in `zod/objectql.zod.ts`; md5 at all four commits; the three gate scripts rerun at the head in the worktree print byte-identical verdict lines, exit 0; `git merge-tree --write-tree` against main `f99f9cde7` exits 0.

### ② Semver level

None owed by this PR: changeset prose only, no package source touched, `check-changeset-presence` says no changeset is owed. The edited entries keep their declared bumps byte-for-byte (`plugin-map: minor`, `core`/`cli`/`console`: patch in 10393).

### ③ Boundary flags

- CI on the head: 40 check runs; every completed run is `success` (or `skipped` for the coverage shards and dependabot); `Test (shard 1/8 … 8/8)` and `Spec Main Shape Gate` were `in_progress` at read time. No red check.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree refs/review/main refs/review/pr-10642` (main `f99f9cde7`) exits 0, tree `d1d4edcd5`; main has not touched any of the three files since base `5add18a67`. PR is behind main, not conflicting.
- Nit, body round-2 paragraph: it quotes the advisory output as one line ending `… schema: view-map.json (type "view:map")`. `check` prints the file on its own indented line after the colon. Suggested wording: `prints the advisory header "1 file carries a registered ObjectUI component type but did not validate as an ObjectUI schema:" followed by "view-map.json (type "view:map")" on the next line, exit 0`. Not blocking.
- Nit, same paragraph: under the "Round 2, head `7467d4e39`" heading the quoted clause carries the round-3 wording ("on the known-type list"); "now reads" makes it accurate at the landing head, and the round-3 paragraph records the swap. Not blocking.
- The GitHub PR currently shows the round-1 title and body; the seat's files supersede both.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-10606-check-bare-doc-changesets`
Reviewed-by: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`

**VERDICT: PASS**
